span.p:
Begin Inspection State:
IsInspecting = true; Pause locomotion
Capture original artifact & player rig transform
Hide pedestal & info icon GameObject

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Trigger EnvironmentDimmer:
EnvironmentDimmer.Begin(brightness = 0.18, duration = 0.35s)
Fade museum gallery materials to dark backdrop

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Bring Artifact to Inspection Distance:
Smoothly glide model to eye distance (0.6m)
Attach OneGrabFreeRotateTransformer & Zoom (0.5x - 3.0x)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Open Inspection Canvas Tablet:
Bind LocalizedString title & description
Reset scroll rect position

Joystick zoom in/out, reads bilingual info panel

EnvironmentDimmer.Restore() -> Fade gallery back to 1.0
Glide artifact back to pedestal & restore rotation
Re-enable visitor locomotion; IsInspecting = false
